notes: Claim statuses travel: softmax/argmax and preference gauge Derived, J-space/EBM/operational-parity Offered. The gauge experiment separation (shift-inert vs reference-acts) is staged as the scene glyph. No scene claims an implemented system; each body keeps the record’s own Open/Offered boundary.

Per-scene moves (2026-10-06 enrichment): comp-softmax-argmax — the six-step sequence drives objectState size as concentration: the distribution forms (blue), shift leaves size untouched (invariance shown, not said), T=2 widens and thins, T→0 narrows and golds, T→∞ spreads widest: temperature read as geometry while the text keeps every exact value. comp-preference-gauge — the swap step physically moves position and flips tint (the preference reverses), shift keeps everything fixed, the new-reference step arrives gold: shift inert, reference acts. comp-j-space — THE 3D SCENE: the three attempts sit at z +0.3 in front of the J surface, the spec behind at z −0.3 (laminate, slab volume, perspective) — permission as the space the attempts live in; the sequence runs refusal (red) → policy change → opening (gold, position lifted). comp-ebm-resonance — three moments separated: inference at θ=2, domain flip to {0,1} (blue), learning moves the parameter (gold, position shift), and the second-order revision scales the tuple glyph; gentle linear morph is movement inside the field, never revision of it. comp-operational-parity — the six tests hold an arc under mild attract forces, the vortex pointer walks them; the watchword sequence derives the parity procedure.

Craft: pointer profiles by meaning — attract for the distribution/gauge readings (the field retained), repel+shove at J-space (publish refused from the touch surface), vortex for the parity walk, plain pulse on EBM. Automation: turbulence LFO (softmax), dispersion LFO (gauge), speed LFO (EBM movement), circulation LFO (parity walk). Durations 12/14 s, transitions 1.5/2.0/2.2 s differ. Honesty guards kept: the softmax analogy stays at selection level (no semantic or soteriological borrowing), the gauge scene keeps its Offered/Derived bands (softmax/gauge DERIVED, J-space/EBM/parity OFFERED), and no scene claims an implemented system.

What the third dimension means (comp-j-space): permission is an operative condition — so the scene builds it as the space the attempts stand in: inspect/edit/publish at the front plane (z +0.3), the J specification at the back (z −0.3), the decision glyph mid-plane, all under slab volume and perspective. The refusal and the later opening are moves the surface makes possible; depth is the difference between acting and the conditions of acting.
description: Computation mathemes: softmax/argmax, preference gauge and reference policy, J-space, energy-based inference, the six operational-parity tests.

glyph_rationales.(m,θ,E)→(m′,θ′,E′): the second-order move — revising what counts as an answer; distinct from inference and from learning.
glyph_rationales.+10: unchanged: shift invariance — a common offset leaves every probability where it was.
glyph_rationales.E1 seam: the first parity test — a seam varied to see whether the declared operation changes.
glyph_rationales.E2 gauge: the gauge test — shift-only changes must be inert for the distinction to hold.
glyph_rationales.E3 lens: the lens test — style-level variation, unable to reach more than presentation.
glyph_rationales.E4 continuity: the topological continuity test — the distinction carried through connected change.
glyph_rationales.E5 recursion: the QL recursion test — where silent promotion is the specified failure.
glyph_rationales.E6 return: the deferential return test — disclaimer as failure mode, specified first.
glyph_rationales.J = J(B, ℓ, φ, s): the permission surface — J as the operative condition the decision lives in, not metadata.
glyph_rationales.T=2: flatten: temperature raises softness — the distribution spreads; concentration is a parameter, not a fact.
glyph_rationales.T→0: one-hot: the cold limit — mass on the maxima; the cut of argmax approached but not identified with it.
glyph_rationales.T→∞: uniform: the hot limit — the distribution flattened to equality; selection dissolved.
glyph_rationales.circumscription, no circumstance: the J-space guard — permissions bound the action without knowing the world it acts in.
glyph_rationales.distribution · max · draw: three different outputs — retaining, cutting, sampling; the analogy holds at selection level only.
glyph_rationales.domain is constitutive: the EBM guard — what inference selects depends on the declared domain, not preference alone.
glyph_rationales.edit ✓: the permitted attempt — the permission surface allows this operation.
glyph_rationales.failure specified first: the parity discipline — each test names its own failure before any promotion.
glyph_rationales.inspect ✓: the permitted attempt — reading the space the decision sits in.
glyph_rationales.keep z, T, candidates, rule: what travels with the cut — the field retained by the distribution view.
glyph_rationales.learn θ: 2→3: learning changes the domain — what inference selects moves; distinct from selecting inside it.
glyph_rationales.new ref: 1/2: changing the reference acts — the gauge floor moves; the zero was occupied.
glyph_rationales.p=(1/7,2/7,4/7): the distribution formed — positive, summing to one; softmax output at the given logits.
glyph_rationales.policy change: the second-order move in J-space — the surface itself revised, not the choice within it.
glyph_rationales.publish ✓ — open: the permission earned — the same operation, the surface changed; gold marks the opening.
glyph_rationales.publish ✕: the refused operation — the boundary the surface enforces; red by authored tint.
glyph_rationales.shift inert · reference acts: the experiment separation — shifts change nothing, references can; confusing them hides a faulty experiment.
glyph_rationales.shift −20: 3/4: the shift stays inert — differences only enter; the gauge floor is unlearnable.
glyph_rationales.swap: 1/4: swapping the pair flips the probability — the difference operation running.
glyph_rationales.vary the distinction, watch the decision: the parity procedure — promotion earned only through declared operational change.
glyph_rationales.what changes?: the EBM test question — a probe of the domain, stated as an open Offered question.
glyph_rationales.z=(0,ln2,ln4): the logits stated before any transformation — object, then operation, then retained relation.
glyph_rationales.{0,1}: min at 1: the same energy on a different domain selects differently — constitutive, not accidental.
glyph_rationales.×2: 9/10: scaling the differences acts — the family is difference-based, not level-based.
glyph_rationales.β·log Z cancels — DPO: the partition function cancels in the difference — why preference objectives are gauge-structured.
glyph_rationales.θ=2: min at 2: inference inside a fixed field — argmin at the declared parameter; movement, not revision.
glyph_rationales.σ(ln3) = 3/4: the logistic gauge worked once — a difference turned into a probability.
